sources.name: Timezone India Locations
sources.example_data_quote: Timezone Inorbit Mall Malad: Arcade, Bowling & VR Games. Opening Hours Monday: 11:00 am - 10:00 pm ... location: Inorbit Mall, 1st & 2nd Floor, New Link Road, Malad (W), Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400064. Tags: Arcade, Birthday, Bowling, Spin Cars, VR.
sources.adds_over_current: Map has only ~4 India Timezone rows (mostly games=['other'], ZIv cab notes like Halo Fireteam Raven, no music games). Official locator lists 76 live venues with stable URL pattern /en-in/locations/{region}/{slug}/ plus address and hours. Does NOT list music/rhythm cabinets (no PIU/DDR/maimai/etc.). High value for venue discovery and filling Other-only gaps; zero game-lineup enrichment without ZIv/field reports.
sources.note: TEEG Timezone India chain. Per-venue pages are HTML with amenity icons (Arcade/Bowling/VR) only. Compared Inorbit Malad: map already has this venue as other-only; source confirms hours/address but adds no games. Not already wired as a pipeline source.

summary: Scouted ME/AF/SA (UAE, Saudi, Israel, Turkey, Egypt, South Africa, Ghana, Morocco, India + neighbors) for structured per-venue music/rhythm databases comparable to hkarcade.fandom.com. Result: no such wiki, community map, or maintained spreadsheet was found that lists multiple venues with per-venue music-game cabinets for this region. Map currently leans almost entirely on ZIv here (Israel ~60, South Africa ~39, UAE ~19, India ~13, Nigeria ~9, Saudi ~5; heavy other-only). What does exist and was opened live are India family-entertainment chain locators: Timezone India (76 venues, best find for coverage gap), Fun City India (35), Smaaash (11), Dave & Buster's India (3, already on map). All give address/hours (and amenity tags like Arcade/VR) via stable URL patterns; none publish maimai/CHUNITHM/SDVX/IIDX/PIU/DDR cab counts. SEGA ALL.Net intl dumps already in-repo have no real ME/AF/SA maimai/CHUNITHM footprint. Israel has active dance-game players (Reddit mentions ~6 PIU sites; Babylon Park / Funland chains dominate the map as ZIv stubs) but no open multi-venue machine wiki. South Africa has a dance-gaming Facebook community and venue posts (PowerPlay, Fun Company, Barcadia) without a scrapeable maintained list. Turkey, Egypt, Saudi, Morocco, Ghana, Pakistan: no dedicated multi-venue music-game source confirmed open today. Priority if wiring anything: Timezone India venue fan-out for Other-only reduction; game lineups still need ZIv, operator socials, or field reports.
dead_ends: magicplanetmena.com (MAF Magic Planet, claimed 32 locations / 9 MENA countries): brand marketing and game catalog pages indexed; public multi-venue locator with addresses timed out / not successfully opened today; MAF brand page https://www.majidalfuttaim.com/en/what-we-do/our-industries/brand/magic-planet confirms scale but no per-venue list. ae.sparkysme.com Sparky's UAE: site live but OTP/mobile-gate blocks content; third-party mall.ae lists ~11 Sparky's malls without cab data. stepmaniax.com/locations/: page responds but rendered empty (JS/app-only; SMX Link app is the real locator, not scrapeable from HTML). Andamiro Pump It Up: no global public location finder found. Israeli Hebrew searches (ארקייד / פאמפ איט אפ / מכונות): no multi-venue machine wiki. Arabic Dubai arcade searches: social/IG only. Turkish (atari salonu / dans makinesi / pump it up): single-venue mentions (Funlab Forum Istanbul already on map), no list. South Africa dance community FB/IG posts and Kingpin/PowerPlay mentions: not a structured multi-venue database. Ghana Game It Up Accra: single venue, not a network list. Reddit r/IndianGaming and r/rhythmgames threads: anecdotal, not maintained lists. Google Maps/Yelp/TripAdvisor intentionally not treated as data sources. ZIv/ALL.Net/e-amusement/WAHLAP/BemaniCN/Round1 USA already excluded as known baseline.
